reference: She had handled the stress well until the third pile arrived.
sk: Stres zvládala dobre, kým nedorazila tretia kopa.
cz: Stres zvládala dobře, dokud nedorazila třetí hromada.
acceptable: She had {handled|coped with|managed|dealt with} the stress well until the third {pile|heap|stack} {arrived|came}.
She had been {handling|coping with|managing|dealing with} the stress well until the third {pile|heap|stack} {arrived|came}.

mistakes.text: She handled the stress well until the third pile arrived.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past Perfect zdôrazní, že zvládanie trvalo až do príchodu kopy: „had handled“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past Perfect zdůrazní, že zvládání trvalo až do příchodu hromady: „had handled“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Perfect stresses that the coping lasted up to the pile's arrival: “had handled”.

mistakes.text: She was handling the stress well until the third pile arrived.
mistakes.kind: Past Continuous instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej trvajúci až po iný minulý moment sa tu precvičuje s Past Perfect: „had handled“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj trvající až do jiného minulého okamžiku se tu procvičuje s Past Perfect: „had handled“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For an action lasting up to another past moment, this exercise practises Past Perfect: “had handled”.

mistakes.text: She had handled the stress well until the third pile didn't arrive.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „until“ je sloveso kladné, hoci po slovensky je „kým nedorazila“: „until … arrived“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „until“ je sloveso kladné, i když česky je „dokud nedorazila“: „until … arrived“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “until” the verb is positive: “until the third pile arrived”, not “didn't arrive”.

mistakes.text: She has handled the stress well until the third pile arrived.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Všetko sa odohralo v minulosti, preto Past Perfect: „had handled“, nie „has handled“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Vše se odehrálo v minulosti, proto Past Perfect: „had handled“, ne „has handled“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Everything is in the past, so use Past Perfect “had handled”, not “has handled”.

mistakes.text: She had handle the stress well until the third pile arrived.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past Perfect tvorí „had“ + past participle: „had handled“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past Perfect se tvoří z „had“ + past participle: „had handled“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Perfect is “had” + past participle: “had handled”.
